last_review.summary: The resolver satisfies AUTH-005-B and D-018: it uses only trusted userId lookup, classifies strictly by the exact stored role, preserves both IDs independently, emits empty scopes, uses one safe authentication failure for missing/invalid mappings, and is registered/exported within the allowed path. Build and Prisma validation passed.

notes: No tests are executed by loop V2.
Do not connect autonomous agents to the production Supabase database.
Core does not exist yet; Auth defines stable seams/contracts but does not implement Core.
Auth->Core internal request auth is Noop in V1; future signed JWT is a pluggable strategy.
